Batch crawl stream emits both Page and Error events for mixed success/failure URLs

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.crawlberg.*;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var MAPPER = new ObjectMapper();
        var engineConfig = MAPPER.readValue("{\"max_concurrent\":1}", CrawlConfig.class);
        var engine = io.xberg.crawlberg.Crawlberg.createEngine(engineConfig);
        java.util.List<String> urls = java.util.List.of("https://example.com/success1", "https://example.com/fail", "https://example.com/success2");
        var urlsReq = new BatchCrawlStreamRequest(urls);
        var result = engine.batchCrawlStream(urlsReq);
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
```
